## ZIP_PLANS_NOT_MERGEABLE

SQLSTATE `42K03`.

~~~text
The two DataFrames in zip() cannot be merged. They must produce the same canonicalized plan after stripping outer Project chains, and must not contain non-scalar Python UDFs.
~~~
